summary: A 28-year-old male climber from Kennesaw, Georgia, took a 15-ft fall onto a ledge ~700 ft up the Petit Grepon climbing route (~12,200 ft), sustaining numerous blunt-force injuries; five unaffiliated climbers lowered him ~600 ft. RMNP SAR reached him at 5 p.m., a park paramedic provided advanced medical care, and the man and rescuers spent the night on a ledge ~20 ft above the talus slope. Monday 6:30 a.m. RMNP SAR with Rocky Mountain Rescue conducted a ~1,000-ft technical rope lower to Sky Pond; he was flown by Flight for Life to Boulder Community Hospital at ~10:15 a.m.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; Rocky Mountain Rescue; Flight for Life
notes: 2017-08-20 was a Sunday (weekday-verified); the man was part of a three-climber group.
